name: Global Historical Climatology Network hourly (GHCNh), Version 1
description: The Global Historical Climatology Network hourly (GHCNh) Version 1 is NOAA NCEI's integrated global archive of land-surface hourly and sub-hourly meteorological observations. Spanning station data from the late 18th century to present, GHCNh unifies multiple global and regional surface sources—including the Integrated Surface Database (ISD), international meteorological agency archives, and historical data rescue initiatives—into an unadjusted, quality-controlled, common-format collection of temperature, dew point, pressure, wind, and precipitation readings under official dataset DOI: 10.25921/jp3d-3v19.

publisher.name: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI)

license.name: U.S. Government Work (17 U.S.C. 105) / Public Domain
license.notes: NOAA publishes GHCNh Version 1 under a U.S. Government Work public domain designation with no federal copyright asserted by the publisher. However, because GHCNh integrates hourly observations contributed by foreign meteorological services and historical archives, downstream users should verify source-country terms for commercial redistribution rather than assuming unencumbered worldwide rights.
